entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-25
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [Android] SslStream on Android 9 (API 28) fails with ArgumentException "SSL_NULL_WITH_NULL_NULL" since .NET 11 Preview 4 — is this expected? #136456
  • DynamicMethod with a function pointer parameter, return type or local throws NotSupportedException on .NET 11 #136453
  • DispatchProxy: calling a method with a non-null pointer argument throws NullReferenceException #136451
  • TypeBuilder (AssemblyBuilderAccess.Run) throws NotSupportedException for signatures that contain modified types #136449
  • [mono] Taking the address of an [UnmanagedCallersOnly] method that returns a function pointer aborts the process ("return type 0x1b unknown") #136448
  • Microsoft Security Advisory CVE-2026-111497 | .NET Brotli Decoder Out-of-bounds Write Vulnerability #136446
  • Microsoft Security Advisory CVE-2026-70197 | .NET and Visual Studio Remote Code Execution Vulnerability | October 25, 2026 OOB update #136445
  • macOS SslStream (UseNetworkFramework): NullReferenceException in SafeDeleteNwContext write-completion callback after Dispose aborts the process when the peer closes during writes #136439
  • Channel.CreateUnbounded(SingleReader = true): Reader.Completion can stay pending forever when the last TryRead races TryComplete #136437
  • [API Proposal]: Bounded-nonnegative `ArgumentOutOfRangeException` throw helpers #136434
  • GetILFunctionBody fails with COR_E_BADIMAGEFORMAT for a method edited by Hot Reload (regression in .NET 11) #136432

Closed

  • Test failure: JIT/Regression/CLR-x86-JIT/V1.2-M01/b03689/b03689/b03689.cmd #136264
  • Test failure: tracing/eventpipe/eventsvalidation/SampleProfilerSampleType/SampleProfilerSampleType.cmd #136197
  • [Mono] [Question] Safety of returning MonoObject* from Native function pointer to C# IntPtr regarding GC collection #122969
